name: Item
description: An item is an object in the games which the player can pick up, keep in their bag, and use in some manner. They have various uses, including healing, powering up, helping catch Pokémon, or to access a new area.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier for this resource.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name for this resource.

fields.name: prices
fields.description: Purchase and sell prices by currency and version group. Prices may be null when the item cannot be bought or sold.

fields.name: fling_power
fields.description: The power of the move Fling when used with this item.

fields.name: fling_effect
fields.description: The effect of the move Fling when used with this item.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: A list of attributes this item has.

fields.name: category
fields.description: The category of items this item falls into.

fields.name: effect_entries
fields.description: The effect of this ability listed in different languages.

fields.name: flavor_text_entries
fields.description: The flavor text of this ability listed in different languages.

fields.name: game_indices
fields.description: A list of game indices relevent to this item by generation.

fields.name: names
fields.description: The name of this item listed in different languages.

fields.name: sprites
fields.description: A set of sprites used to depict this item in the game.

fields.name: held_by_pokemon
fields.description: A list of Pokémon that might be found in the wild holding this item.

fields.name: baby_trigger_for
fields.description: An evolution chain this item requires to produce a bay during mating.

fields.name: machines
fields.description: A list of the machines related to this item.

fields.name: default
fields.description: The default depiction of this item.

fields.name: pokemon
fields.description: The Pokémon that holds this item.

fields.name: version_details
fields.description: The details for the version that this item is held in by the Pokémon.

fields.name: rarity
fields.description: How often this Pokémon holds this item in this version.

fields.name: version
fields.description: The version that this item is held in by the Pokémon.

fields.name: purchase_price
fields.description: The purchase price in this currency and version group, or null if unavailable.

fields.name: sell_price
fields.description: The sell price in this currency and version group, or null if unavailable.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The currency used for this price.

fields.name: version_group
fields.description: The version group to which this price applies.
